Italy is blessed with a dry warm climate that preserves old classics so rust is seldom an issue. The quality of stock here is among the very best in the world. I personally inspect every car I sell. I travel the length of Italy finding and purchasing cars to offer as stock or purchased to order through my brokerage service. I enjoy meeting the owners of the cars and hearing their history of ownership and fond memories, the stories behind the metal.
